content:
{'text': '特朗總統週一在內布拉斯加州格蘭德艾蘭的中期選舉造勢大會上談及對伊朗戰爭時，引起部分觀察人士警慮。他表示這場戰爭的代價「略高」，但最終只是一個「非常小的代價」，其後更似乎暗示伊朗可以襲擊加州兩個主要城市。', 'source_text': 'President Donald Trump alarmed some observers on Monday when he discussed the war in Iran at a midterm campaign rally in Grand Island, Nebraska, saying the cost of the war was "a little rich," but ultimately just a "very small price," and then seemingly suggested Iran could strike two major cities in California.'}

{'text': '「為了讓世界安全、讓我們國家安全，這是一個非常小的代價。他們可以摧毀一座城市——就讓他們摧毀洛杉磯吧，就讓他們摧毀聖地牙哥吧。」他說道。「這是一個非常小的代價，戰爭很快便會結束。其實，幾乎已經結束了。他們可能會拖長一點，你知道的，他們總是說自己有很高的忍耐痛楚能力；他們必須那樣做。我跟你說，他們必須那樣做。但很快就會結束。」', 'source_text': '"It\'s a very small price to pay, for the safety of the world and the safety of our country. They can destroy a city — let them destroy Los Angeles, let them destroy San Diego," he said. "It\'s a very small price, the war will be over soon. Actually, it\'s almost over. They may drag it a little bit, you know, they always say they have a high tolerance for pain; they have to do that. I\'ll tell you, they have to do that. But it\'s gonna be over soon."'}

{'text': '週二有記者要求特朗普說明「讓他們摧毀洛杉磯、讓他們摧毀聖地牙哥」是何意思時，特朗普似乎對提問不予理會。', 'source_text': 'Trump appeared to brush off a reporter on Tuesday who asked him to clarify what he meant by "let them destroy Los Angeles, let them destroy San Diego."'}

{'text': '當特朗普提及伊朗「摧毀」這兩座城市時，台下群眾歡呼喝采。該活動是為共和黨內布拉斯加州參議員Pete Ricketts助選的造勢場合。', 'source_text': 'The crowd cheered when Trump mentioned Iran "destroying" the two cities. The event was a campaign rally for Republican Sen. Pete Ricketts of Nebraska.'}

{'text': '美國與以色列於2月28日對伊朗發動協調導彈攻擊，掀起動輒數月的戰事。據《HuffPost》報導，總統聲稱攻打伊朗的戰事有必要，目的是防止伊朗研發核武及保護以色列。', 'source_text': 'The U.S. and Israel launched a coordinated missile attack against Iran on Feb. 28, kicking off a war that has lasted months. The president has claimed the war in Iran is necessary to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons and to protect Israel, according to HuffPost.'}

{'text': '加州州長Gavin Newsom週二早上在X發文，批評有關言論「危險——而且可能構成叛國」。他寫道：「這形同在加州兩座最大城市、以及美國其中一個最大軍港身上掛上目標牌。我已指示州政府威脅評估中心積極監察相關情況，以防外國行為者將總統的言論解讀為攻擊加州的邀請。」', 'source_text': 'California Gov. Gavin Newsom posted on X Tuesday morning, calling the comments "dangerous — and potentially treasonous." He wrote: "This is tantamount to putting a target on the backs of two of California’s largest cities, and one of America’s largest military ports. I’ve directed the state’s Office of Threat Assessment to actively monitor the situation in the event foreign actors interpret the President’s comments as an invitation to attack California."'}

{'text': '聖地牙哥市長Todd Gloria在官方聲明中表示：「特朗普總統應該收回這些言論，並向聖地牙哥市民道歉。總統無權決定哪些美國社區值得受到保護。」', 'source_text': 'San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria said in an official statement: "President Trump should retract these comments and apologize to the people of San Diego. The President has no right to decide which American communities deserve protection."'}

{'text': '洛杉磯市長Karen Bass在X發文，批評總統的言論「危險」，並表示總統應該專注於保護美國人，而非鼓勵襲擊美國城市。', 'source_text': 'Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass posted on X criticizing the president\'s comments as "dangerous," and said the president should focus on protecting Americans, not encouraging attacks on American cities.'}

{'text': '白宮將《HuffPost》轉介至白宮傳訊總監Steven Cheung的X帖文，當中他表示特朗普「已清楚表明，若不遏止擁有核武的伊朗，美國城市便會受到威脅。美國因為這位總統而更安全。伊朗沒有核武、沒有海軍、沒有空軍，也沒有金錢。」', 'source_text': 'The White House referred HuffPost to a post on X by White House director of communications Steven Cheung, who said Trump "has made it clear that American cities would be under threat without stopping a nuclear Iran. America is safer because of this President. Iran has no nukes, no navy, no air force, and no money."'}

{'text': '截至本文發佈時，特朗普仍未公開澄清其言論。Ricketts的辦公室在本文發佈前亦未回應《HuffPost》的置評請求。', 'source_text': "As of the publication of this article, Trump had not publicly clarified his comments. Ricketts' office did not respond to HuffPost's request for comment before the time of publication."}

{'text': '貝勒大學傳播系修辭學教授Luke Winslow向《HuffPost》表示，相比歷任總統的戰時言論，這種措辭實屬前所未見。', 'source_text': 'Baylor University communications and rhetoric professor Luke Winslow told HuffPost that the wording is unprecedented compared to wartime rhetoric from previous presidents.'}

{'text': 'Winslow指出：「一般而言，總統的戰時修辭旨在團結國家，而非分化國家。但從某個角度而言，這正正符合特朗普作為總統的前所未見風格。」', 'source_text': '"In general, presidential wartime rhetoric is meant to unite the country, not divide it. But in some ways, this is on brand for the unprecedented nature of Trump as president," Winslow noted.'}

{'text': 'Winslow指出，特朗普在兩屆任期內一直高度重視忠誠度測試，並希望在中期選舉前動員出席活動的群眾。', 'source_text': 'Winslow noted that Trump has prioritized loyalty tests throughout his two terms in office, and has wanted to mobilize the crowd at the events before the midterms.'}

{'text': '「他說話的內容旨在製造刺激和吸人注意。大多數人都會認同，他的政治天才在於能夠吸引眼球、操控新聞周期——我們已見證了十年。他的招數就是說一些他知道會成為頭條或令群眾亢奮的話。」Winslow說道。', 'source_text': '"The content of what he says is designed to be provocative and to draw attention. Most would agree that his political genius has been in being able to draw eyes and to control the news cycle — we’ve seen that for a decade. His trick is to say things he knows will make headlines or fire up the crowd," Winslow said.'}

{'text': '堪薩斯大學傳播系教授Robert Rowland亦指出，群眾的反應成為總統的助力與肯定。', 'source_text': "University of Kansas communications professor Robert Rowland also pointed out that the crowd's response became an enabler and a validation for the president."}

{'text': '「聽到洛杉磯或聖地牙哥可能遭受攻擊的想法，誰會發笑？」Rowland問道。他續稱：「他們笑的不是真正實質攻擊的概念。他們的笑聲反映了他們對沿海精英的不滿。」', 'source_text': '"Who laughs at the thought of Los Angeles or San Diego being attacked?" Rowland asked. He continued: "They’re not laughing at the concept of an actual, physical attack. Their laughter reflects their dissatisfaction with coastal elites."'}

{'text': 'Rowland表示，與歷任總統不同，特朗普亦會針對特定群體，以及他對美國某些特定群體的個人恩怨。', 'source_text': 'Rowland said that unlike previous presidents, Trump also targets specific groups, as well as his personal grievances with certain groups in America.'}

{'text': '「修辭技巧最出色的總統（列根和奧巴馬）着眼於人們的共同點。從歷史上看，將某些群體描繪成並非『真正的』美國人、屬於『他者』的修辭，有可能激發極端組織。同時，這類修辭亦可能間接助長政治暴力。」他說道。', 'source_text': '"The most rhetorically skilled presidents [Reagan and Obama] focused on what people had in common. Historically, rhetoric that portrays some group as not ‘real’ Americans, as ‘the other,’ has the potential to activate extremist organizations. At the same time, this kind of rhetoric can indirectly foster political violence," he said.'}

{'text': '特朗普有否犯下叛國罪？', 'source_text': 'Has Trump committed treason?'}

{'text': 'Newsom的帖文提出一種可能性：特朗普的言論可被描述為「叛國」。叛國是《憲法》定義的法律術語，即「對（美國）發動戰爭，或依附其敵人、給予敵人協助及慰藉。任何人士除非經兩名證人就同一公開行為作證，或在公開法庭上認罪，否則不得被裁定叛國罪。」', 'source_text': 'Newsom\'s post raised the possibility that Trump\'s comments could be described as "treasonous." Treason is a legal term defined in the Constitution as "levying War against [the U.S.], or in adhering to their Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort. No Person shall be convicted of Treason unless on the Testimony of two Witnesses to the same overt Act, or on Confession in open Court."'}

{'text': '不過，曾接受《HuffPost》訪問的法律專家表示，特朗普的言論並不構成叛國罪，因為叛國罪的定義非常精確。', 'source_text': "However, legal experts who spoke with HuffPost said Trump's comments did not amount to treason, because the definition of treason is very specific."}

{'text': '聖路易斯華盛頓大學法律教授Greg Magarian向《HuffPost》表示：「《憲法》對叛國的理解非常狹窄；它只涵蓋對美國發動戰爭，或向美國的敵人提供協助及慰藉，而在此個案中，無論你怎麼看特朗普……他是在談論如何打贏這場戰爭的脈絡下說出這些話。」', 'source_text': '"The constitutional understanding of treason is quite narrow; it only covers levying war against the United States, or giving aid and comfort to enemies of the United States, and in this case, however you look at Trump... he was making these comments in the context of talking about winning a war," Greg Magarian, a law professor at Washington University in St. Louis, told HuffPost.'}

{'text': 'Magarian補充：「沒有任何跡象顯示他正在投降、正在幫助另一方、或想向伊朗提供轟炸洛杉磯的藍圖。所以這根本算不上（叛國）。」', 'source_text': 'Magarian added: "There\'s no indication he\'s surrendering, helping the other side, or wanting to give Iran a blueprint to bomb Los Angeles. So that doesn\'t even come close."'}

{'text': 'Cheung的聲明辯稱，特朗普描述的是美國若不遏止伊朗可能會發生的事，而非表示伊朗應該攻擊洛杉磯和聖地牙哥。加州大學戴維斯分校法學院法律教授Carl Larson接受《HuffPost》訪問時表示，如果是後者，則可能構成特朗普發動戰爭，但叛國罪仍須涉及使用武力及向伊朗提供協助。', 'source_text': "Cheung's statement argued that Trump was describing what would happen to the U.S. if Iran were not stopped, not saying that Iran should attack Los Angeles and San Diego. Carl Larson, a law professor at the University of California, Davis School of Law, told HuffPost that if it were the latter, it could amount to Trump levying war, but treason would still require the use of force and aiding Iran."}

{'text': 'Larson指出：「所有發動戰爭的案例都需要實際使用武力，而特朗普此舉只是一場演說。這些案例同時需要實際向敵人提供協助及慰藉，而這篇冗長的演說很可能不符合真正協助及慰藉的定義。」', 'source_text': '"All of the levying war cases require an actual use of force, and what Trump did is a speech. And those cases also require actually giving aid and comfort to the enemy, and a long-winded speech like this one would likely not meet the definition of actual aid and comfort," Larson noted.'}
